scope: Insert missing DetailViewStyle group-1 identifier height, arrow size, and identifier offset values (DXF group 40) from edited typed values during same-version raw-carrier export.

implementation.behavior: The DetailViewStyle overlay finds the highest edited missing group-1 double occurrence and inserts each missing occurrence through that slot. Earlier values come from the typed record, including defaults needed as ordinal placeholders. Newly inserted values must be finite and are lexically encoded with max_digits10 round-trip precision.

Compare the complete ordered raw DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle carriers and verify the following POINT survives.

limitations: Same-source-version DXF typed-field insertion/replay only; no DWG-origin typed serialization or cross-version projection qualification.
The generated control addresses one later-slot omission pattern; it does not establish semantic handling for malformed or ambiguous raw cardinalities.
No native style-rendering or broad DetailViewStyle semantic-completeness claim follows.
